sourceOfTruth: Azure Boards WIQL operator table: HTML/PlainText long-text fields (System.Description) accept only Contains Words / Not Contains Words / Is Empty / Is Not Empty

cycle-state.mjs reconcileCreatedIssue: host.pm.findCards({repo, search: marker}) then filters rows by body.includes(marker); matches 0 -> new-card-remote-outcome-uncertain, >1 -> new-card-reconciliation-ambiguous; a thrown findCards -> <prefix>-issue-list-failed
az boards query returns only the SELECTed fields

Boundary evidence: NONE available for Contains Words match semantics on HTML-comment text, nor for HTML-comment persistence in System.Description (no Azure DevOps org/credentials for a probe; no authoritative citation obtainable in this environment) -> option (b) of rejection r1-g3-c2: the stub is conservative on both unknowns
Operator table (the existing oracle) states CONTAINS on String fields / System.Tags; Tags CONTAINS modelled as whole-tag equality, a subset of either real reading (substring or whole tag)

Field existence (rejection r1-g3-c2 attempt 2, unproven-field-existence-on-create): no boundary evidence that any Custom.* field exists in the target process; only the core System.* fields defined by every stock process template (System.Id/Title/Description/Tags/TeamProject/WorkItemType/State/Reason/AssignedTo/AreaPath/IterationPath/History/Created*/Changed*/Rev) are assumed to exist -> stub refuses any other --fields name on create/update (TF51535) and any other field in a WIQL SELECT or clause (TF51005)
System.Tags is the only field present in every process whose CONTAINS semantics the operator table states; it is the one route with proven semantics

Tag value (rejection r1-g3-c2 attempt 3, unproven-tag-value-acceptance): no boundary evidence that Azure Boards accepts, stores verbatim and whole-tag-matches a tag carrying markup/spaces -> stub refuses on create/update any ';'-separated System.Tags entry outside /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,399}$/ (TF401320 InvalidCharacters); the ONE admitted tag is pinned: pair-scope-decision-<the marker's 32 hex> (maintainer direction, maintainer-interventions.md, redRepairs 3)
findCards is a generic PM_METHODS entry (adapter-kit.mjs) taking ANY search; github.mjs implements it as a generic search -> the non-marker complement is a supported input class

inventory.producer: scripts/host/azure-devops.mjs findCards({repo, search}) — builds the WIQL passed to `az boards query --wiql` (12 byte-identical copies)
inputs: repo '<project>/<repository>' (project may contain a single quote)
search = ANY text (generic PM_METHODS findCards): the hidden decision marker `<!-- pair:scope-decision:<32hex> -->` (punctuation-heavy) OR an ordinary non-marker text (e.g. 'login page')
Azure Boards work items: System.Description (HTML long-text), System.Title, System.TeamProject, optional String fields/tags
consumers: cycle-state.mjs reconcileCreatedIssue (new-card scope decision: `creating` ledger resume and immediate post-failure reconciliation)
createCard (writes the marker into --description, the body reconciliation filters on)
classes: WIQL operator on System.Description valid for a long-text field (witness w1)
marker on exactly one card created by createCard, HTML comment NOT persisted by the service -> findCards returns that card with number/url/title and a body carrying the marker (witness w2)
createCard -> readCard round trip keeps the marker in body under HTML sanitization (witness w3; verifyCreatedIssueContent requires it)
project scoping with quote doubling; marked card in another project excluded (boundary b1)
create landed, response lost, comment not persisted -> reconciled onto that card, no second create (interaction i1)
create never landed, foreign card sharing title only -> remote-outcome-uncertain, not list failure (interaction i2)
two cards created with the marker -> reconciliation-ambiguous (interaction i3)
createCard hands the marker to the service in --description argv (control c1; not persistence evidence)

stub encodes the oracle conservatively: plain CONTAINS on Description refused; Contains Words valid but proves no match; HTML comments dropped on save; Tags CONTAINS whole-tag; only SELECTed fields ; an invented Custom.* field refused on create, update, WIQL clause and SELECT; System.Tags writable on create (control c2); a System.Tags entry outside the ordinary charset (raw marker, markup, spaces) refused on create/update, the hex-derived tag accepted (control c2)

the one admitted route: createCard argv carries `--fields System.Tags=pair-scope-decision-<marker 32hex>` and every findCards WIQL uses `[System.Tags] CONTAINS 'pair-scope-decision-<32hex>'` (witness w4; pinned again for the cycle-state decision key in i1)

ordinary non-marker search (the complement of the marker route): every WIQL avoids plain CONTAINS on System.Description and az boards query accepts it — validity only, no match asserted because Contains Words matches nothing in the stub (witness w5)
interactions: findCards WIQL x reconcileCreatedIssue body filter (cycle-state.mjs, outside fixScope): the row body the adapter returns must carry the marker even when System.Description lost the comment

findCards x createCard: the marker must be reachable through a route with stated semantics on a field that exists in every process — System.Tags, which createCard also writes; a Custom.* field does not exist on a stock process (create itself fails); Contains Words on Description proves nothing (stub matches none); the tag VALUE must be an ordinary tag — exactly pair-scope-decision-<32hex>, the raw marker is refused by the stub on create
createCard x readCard x verifyCreatedIssueContent: readCard body must carry the marker after the sanitizing save (w3, i1)
